messages:
Jordan P.: Postmortem follow-up: summarize GPU capacity/autoscale remediation items and assign owners. We saw three recurring triggers: nightly batch reruns, canary storms, and unexpected client spikes. Need owners, quick mitigations, and medium-term controls.
Ellen V.: I'll take scheduler tuning + canary plan. Initial changes: reduce eviction frequency, bump min_pool_headroom to 8%, and prefer preemptible eviction order by job age. Will test in staging first.
Marcus W.: I'll own quota enforcement and routing. Proposal: soft quota alert at 82% cluster GPU util, automated routing of low-priority requests to model-compact at soft breach, hard throttle at 94%. Will draft RFC.
Jordan P.: Quick mitigations due this week: Ellen to push staging canary config by Thu, Marcus to open RFC + staging prototype by Fri. Also need a surge runbook owner.
sre-bot: Created follow-up ticket REM-8202 and attached postmortem: https://drive.redwood.ai/postmortems/INC-2024-9952
Ellen V.: Canary plan: 1) traffic replay of last 3 peak days in staging, 2) 2-pool prod canary (gpu-burst + gpu-small) for 6h, 3) monitor latency and OOMs. Config snippet I'll propose in PR to infra-config.
Marcus W.: Routing rules sketch: if header X-Client-Priority=low -> route to model-compact; if cluster_soft > 0.82 -> inject 429 for non-critical batch jobs. Circuit-breaker tunables will be in RFC. Linking temp borrowing idea: allow gpu-burst to lease from gpu-large with 20m TTL.
Jordan P.: Runbook needed: detect spike (>10% above baseline for 3m), who to page (oncall + owners), quick actions (flip circuit-breaker, reserve nodes, rollback canaries). Who volunteers to author it?
Ellen V.: I can draft the runbook (short playbook + commands). ETA: 48h for initial draft.
Marcus W.: I'll add alerting changes to #incidents and wire automated dashboard panels for soft/hard quota metrics.
capacity-bot: Uploaded capacity history: https://reports.redwood.ai/headroom/pools_8weeks.csv (gpu-large,gpu-small,gpu-burst).
Jordan P.: Nightly safety test: run a 7m synthetic spike against staging autoscaler every night, results posted to ci/ops channel. Ellen will add CI job.
Ellen V.: Done — adding job under ci/ops/smoke-spikes.
Jordan P.: Recap owners: Ellen = scheduler + canary + runbook; Marcus = quota/routing + RFC + dashboard; Jordan = coordinate + validation. Track in REM-8202. Update subtasks when you start. :thumbsup:
